name: Data Analyzer: A JSON list with too many rows is refused with HTTP 413 before any table is built
objective: Proves the row limit is checked on the raw JSON, so a huge file cannot use memory first. HTTP 413 means 'too large'. Runs on both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send a JSON list of 6 records with the row limit set to 5.
steps.expected: HTTP 413 and the message mentions 'rows'; the trap is never triggered.

name: Data Analyzer: A JSON list with too many columns is refused with HTTP 413 before any table is built
objective: Proves the column limit is checked on the raw JSON, counting columns across all records. Runs on both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send 2 records with different keys (4 columns in total) with the column limit set to 3.
steps.expected: HTTP 413 and the message mentions 'columns'; the trap is not triggered.

name: Data Analyzer: A JSON object of columns over the limits is refused before any table is built
objective: Proves the same row and column limits apply to the column-wise JSON shape. Runs on both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send {a, b, c} with one value each with the column limit 2.

name: Data Analyzer: JSON text over the byte limit is refused with HTTP 413 before any table is built
objective: Proves the size limit on the JSON text itself, and that the error names the setting to change. Runs on both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send a record containing 100 'x' characters with the JSON byte limit set to 50.
steps.expected: HTTP 413 and the message contains DATA_ANALYZER_MAX_JSON_BYTES.

name: Data Analyzer: Very deeply nested JSON is refused with HTTP 400, not a server crash
objective: Proves nesting 25 or 5000 levels deep gives a clear user error instead of HTTP 500. Runs for both depths on both routes. both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send text made of 25 (then 5000) opening brackets followed by the same number of closing brackets.

name: Data Analyzer: JSON that is a plain number, text or null is refused with a clear HTTP 400
objective: Proves unusable top-level JSON values are rejected with the same message every time. Runs for 3 values on both routes.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model. The table-building library is replaced by a trap that fails the test if it is ever called.

steps.action: Send the JSON value 5, then "x", then null.
steps.expected: HTTP 400 and the message says 'list of records or an object of columns'.

name: Data Analyzer: Normal JSON files in either layout still analyse correctly
objective: Proves the new checks do not break good input. Runs on both analyze routes (file upload and inline data).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and the request-rate counters reset. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Analyse a 2-record list, then the equivalent object of columns.
steps.expected: Both get HTTP 200 and report 2 rows.

name: Data Analyzer: The JSON size limit can never exceed the overall upload limit
objective: Proves a generous JSON setting is capped by the overall limit, and the default is 25 MB (26,214,400 bytes).
precondition: No server request; the library function is called directly.

steps.action: Set the JSON limit to 1,000,000 and ask for the effective limit with an overall limit of 500.
Remove the setting and ask with an overall limit of 1,000,000,000.

name: Data Analyzer: The data loading library applies the same JSON limits
objective: Proves the limits also protect the loader used outside the web service.
precondition: No server request; the loader is called directly with the row limit set to 2.

steps.expected: A 'data too large' error is raised.
An error whose message mentions 'nested' is raised.

name: Data Analyzer: A production service that cannot tell callers apart logs one start-up warning
objective: Proves operators are warned when the caller address is shared, so the wrong-key lockout is weaker.
precondition: Server application in the offline test harness; environment says production; the trusted-proxy hop setting is absent.

steps.action: Run the start-up check while capturing warning logs.
steps.expected: The check returns true and exactly one log line contains 'client_id_shared_mode'.

name: Data Analyzer: The shared-address warning depends on the environment and the hop setting
objective: Proves the warning appears only for a deployed service without a working hop setting. Runs for 3 cases.
precondition: Server application in the offline test harness; the container-name variable is removed.

steps.action: Run the start-up check in each case.
steps.data: Production with hops 1; production with hops 0; development with hops empty
steps.expected: Results are false, true and false respectively.

name: Data Analyzer: The service start-up runs the warning check and still starts
objective: Proves the warning is wired into start-up and does not stop the service.
precondition: Server application in the offline test harness; environment says production; no hop setting.

steps.action: Run the service's start-up routine while capturing warning logs.
steps.expected: It completes without error and a log line contains 'client_id_shared_mode'.
